title: Site allowed_origins are stored but never enforced
description:
`POST /sites` persists `allowed_origins`, but no router path (job create, job read, redeem) checks the request `Origin` against it, so a leaked site key works from any origin. `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` already lists origin registration and enforcement as planned work.

Needs a design pass (Origin header is client-controlled outside browsers; decide on exact match vs wildcard subdomains, behavior for empty lists, and signed audio URL scoping to origin) before a Story brief.
